item.title: Gamesforum Digest 2026-08-13
item.description:
UA spending is hitting diminishing returns as paid install share rises and retention collapses within a month, pushing studios to redirect budget toward first-party, real-money rewards for existing players instead of only chasing new installs.

Sources (5):

  1. Mobile Gaming’s Spend-to-Grow Model Is Evolving (Gamesforum)
  2. Mobile games make $6.6bn in July as Honor of Kings leads player spending (PocketGamer.biz)
  3. Tripledot acquires Supersonic from Unity for $40m (PocketGamer.biz)
  4. Cheat Code for LTV Growth: Why Rewarding Existing Players May Be Mobile Gaming’s Next Growth Lever (Gamesforum)
  5. Pokémon Go revenue rockets to a four-year high of $141.5m during anniversary month (PocketGamer.biz)
